title: Absolute must see places around Utah?
summary:
Hey all, going to visit Salt Lake City end of June for 10 days, never been in the region and Iam a foreigner. Wanted to take a car and drive in the state and around. Thought of visiting Uinta Mountains, Grand Teton, Sawtooth Range, maybe RSNP in Colorado, Yellowstone, maybe gamble in casino once (?)

Locals, need your advices! I like hiking, nature, mountains, authentic villages and historical spots, romantic places to visit and stay. Please advise.
